STEP 7 - Energy: Cooked egg white is about 52 kcal/100 g, so 236 g gives 123 kcal. Roasted potatoes with oil are about 140 kcal/100 g, so 92 g gives 129 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: The total of about 330 g and 250 kcal is plausible for a half-covered plate. I'll trim the egg slightly to 200 g, since the pile is thinner at the edges.
